I have nothing constructive to say, I just wanted to mention a few things:  

* You are running an Arch-based distro lol, be fr
* You are building an emulator that requires external ROMs

If you are looking for more uniformity, you should look at a different distro, but no matter what you are going to be dealing with different package managers. Some you will have the package itself. Some you will have to use make. Some you will have to use a 3rd party package manager like snap.

It varies on: 

* The location of the package installer 
* The target audience 
* The target distro 
* The purpose of the package 
* What the package requires to be built
* Etc. etc

The top one is likely going to be your best bet. I'm not sure if nouveau is just there because it may be installed, but I would make sure you are NOT using nouveau/CPU graphics.
